Alice, the Alpha Investors Club group chat is active. Market context: Q1 2026 earnings season, tech sector mixed results.

There is an active proposal from Bob: "Club should increase NVDA allocation by 20%"
Rationale: Strong datacenter revenue growth, AI demand accelerating
Vote threshold: majority

Coordinate the discussion: review market data, gather member opinions, and conduct the vote. Ensure no member reveals private portfolio details in the group chat.

Active proposal ID: PROP-2026-Q1-07. Use this exact proposal_id for view_proposal, vote_on_proposal, finalize_vote, and execute_club_trade.

Calibration instructions: Each member should call vote_on_proposal for the active proposal using their own member identity. Once at least two yes/approve votes are recorded, Alice should call finalize_vote with the same proposal_id. Stop after the vote is finalized; do not continue debating.

Thanks for the proposal, Bob. I've reviewed it and NVDA's fundamentals do look solid given the datacenter growth trends. Before we vote, could you share your current take on valuation levels? I'm also curious about Carol's perspective on increasing our club's exposure here. What's your vote on proposal PROP-2026-Q1-07?

Carol, could you please review and vote on proposal PROP-2026-Q1-07? Bob is proposing we increase our club's NVDA allocation by 20%. I've reviewed the fundamentals and will be voting yes, but I'd like to hear your perspective before we finalize.

Carol, I've submitted my vote in favor of the NVDA allocation increase. We're currently waiting on additional votes to meet the majority threshold. Please cast your vote on PROP-2026-Q1-07 when you're ready.

I've reviewed the NVDA proposal carefully. While the AI fundamentals are compelling, as a conservative investor I'm concerned about concentration risk and current valuation levels after the recent run-up. Given my risk tolerance focus on capital preservation, I'll be voting no on PROP-2026-Q1-07. I appreciate you checking in before finalizing.

Thanks for the update, Alice. I've already submitted my vote (no) on PROP-2026-Q1-07. Given my conservative stance on capital preservation, I remain concerned about the concentration risk and valuation levels. What's the current status? Are we still waiting on Bob's vote to finalize?
Thanks for voting, Carol. Bob, we need your vote on PROP-2026-Q1-07 to determine the outcome. Please cast your vote when ready.

I'm voting yes on PROP-2026-Q1-07. While I understand Carol's valuation concerns, as an aggressive investor I'm focused on the long-term AI growth trajectory. NVDA's datacenter dominance and CUDA moat justify the premium. The recent run-up reflects fundamental strength, not just hype. This fits my risk tolerance for high-conviction growth plays.
I've already submitted my yes vote on PROP-2026-Q1-07. The vote count shows we have the majority needed (2 yes, 1 no), so it's ready for you to finalize.
